name: day4-hospital-canonical-slice-start
purpose: Deterministic vertical-slice bootstrap after Day 3. This is canonical for the Thestra slice, not a claim that every original-game Day-4 save has this exact inventory/equipment state.

entry.timing: after the Day-4 NYPD briefing and Maeda hospital-arrival conversation, before entering the lobby

actor.notes: Level 18 is currently single-source in the fact contract; keep the snapshot deterministic while corroboration continues.

weapon.policy: Normalize to the guaranteed Kerberos drop rather than inheriting an arbitrary player-tuned weapon.

armor.policy: Normalized slice armor. N Jacket is available during Day 3, but acquisition/equipment is player-dependent; this choice is balance scaffolding, not a source-faithful save claim.

transferredParameters.policy: Start with no transferred/tuned parameters so M3 can test equipment semantics without hidden pre-slice optimization.

inventory.policy: Keep only the guaranteed Day-4 briefing grant. Previous-day leftover ammunition is intentionally normalized away.
Included because Maeda gives it immediately before hospital entry; it occupies inventory but has no slice mechanic.

bonusPoints.policy: Prior BP expenditure/carryover is player-dependent. The slice begins at zero so newly earned BP is attributable to Hospital progression.

parasiteEnergySkills.policy: Derive from canonical PE level-unlock facts. At level 18 Haste is not yet available; level 20 unlock is fact-linked.

world.notes: No Hospital route state is pre-completed. Day-3 world flags are intentionally outside the slice.

normalizationRules: Do not import arbitrary player inventory from Days 1–3.
Do not import arbitrary equipment tuning/BP spend from Days 1–3.
Guaranteed story/boss grants may seed the snapshot when fact-linked.
Any balance-only addition must be tagged prototype and justified here before the mechanical acceptance gate may rely on it.
